maya: Noticing Remora Health onboarding p95 jump after last model pin. p95 ~2.3s vs baseline ~0.95s. Traffic profile: mostly short chat prompts, a few long-document requests. No error increase. Proactive plan: 5% canary to compact-int4, enable prefix cache on short-chat route, reduce max_batch_wait_ms, and add a rollback guard. Need SE + SRE ack.

diego: Drop dashboard link and token distro?

maya: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/remora/latency
maya: Token distro: 75% <80 tokens, 22% 80-512, 3% >512. Spike aligned with a partner integration increasing concurrency.

ash: Agrees. Proposed steps: 1) Canary 5% -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, 2) enable prefix/KV cache for short route with TTL=30s, 3) set batching.max_batch_wait_ms=6 for short route, 4) fallback to original model on 3 consecutive p95 breaches.

maya: Risk summary: model swap = low semantic variance (mitigate with 10-prompt eval set), cache = medium (stale prefix if dynamic system prompts; mitigate with short TTL + mismatch alerts), batching = medium (throughput impact; mitigate with burst autoscale). I can own the canary run and customer comms.

diego: Draft route override snippet below. Also recommend client-side micro-retry to smooth transients.

```yaml
route: /v1/chat/completions
canary_percent: 5
model: redwood-compact-13b-int4
overrides:
  batching:
    max_batch_wait_ms: 6
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
  cache:
    prefix_cache: true
    ttl_ms: 30000
```

ash: I will add an autoscale guard and tracing for top-3 endpoints. ops-bot, schedule a 20m canary at 11:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: start=5222223800 (11:00 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=maya. Command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`

maya: Notifying Remora Health: "Running a 20-minute canary at 11:00 UTC to test compact model + caching on short-chat traffic. No downtime expected. We'll share results and revert if needed." I'll attach the eval prompts. :thumbsup:

diego: Monitoring p50/p95, queue length, eval metrics. Abort if semantic score drops >2% or p95 regresses.

ash: Tracing enabled. Will post results in this thread within 30m after canary: p50/p95, KV hit rate, eval deltas. Thanks team"
